message.content:
The command to publish your portfolio is `wrangler pages deploy public --project-name akira-shirase-oss --branch main`. 

Pushing to GitHub does not automatically publish your portfolio. You need to build your site using `zola build` and then use the Wrangler CLI command to deploy the built files to the hosting service.

final_answer:
The command to publish your portfolio is `wrangler pages deploy public --project-name akira-shirase-oss --branch main`. 

Pushing to GitHub does not automatically publish your portfolio. You need to build your site using `zola build` and then use the Wrangler CLI command to deploy the built files to the hosting service.
